hebrewText: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֡וּא יְגַלַּ֣ח אֲדֹנָ/י֩ בְּ/תַ֨עַר הַ/שְּׂכִירָ֜ה בְּ/עֶבְרֵ֤י נָהָר֙ בְּ/מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר אֶת הָ/רֹ֖אשׁ וְ/שַׂ֣עַר הָ/רַגְלָ֑יִם וְ/גַ֥ם אֶת הַ/זָּקָ֖ן תִּסְפֶּֽה

tokens.bdb: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
tokens.kjv: age, [phrase] always, [phrase] chronicals, continually(-ance), daily, ((birth-), each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone), [phrase] elder, [idiom] end, [phrase] evening, [phrase] (for) ever(-lasting, -more), [idiom] full, life, as (so) long as (... live), (even) now, [phrase] old, [phrase] outlived, [phrase] perpetually, presently, [phrase] remaineth, [idiom] required, season, [idiom] since, space, then, (process of) time, [phrase] as at other times, [phrase] in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), [idiom] whole ([phrase] age), (full) year(-ly), [phrase] younger.

tokens.bdb: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.enLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanation: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanationEn: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self

tokens.bdb: properly, to be bald, i.e. (causatively) to shave; figuratively to lay waste
the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
a knife or razor (as making bare); also a scabbard (as being bare, i.e. empty)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a knife or razor ; also a scabbard (as being bare
tokens.enLiteralWord: a knife or razor ; also a scabbard (as being bare
tokens.explanation: a knife or razor ; also a scabbard (as being bare
tokens.explanationEn: a knife or razor ; also a scabbard (as being bare

tokens.bdb: properly, a region across; but used only adverbially (with or without a preposition) on the opposite side (especially of the Jordan; ususally meaning the east)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] against, beyond, by, [idiom] from, over, passage, quarter, (other, this) side, straight.

tokens.bdb: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile
tokens.enLiteralWord: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile
tokens.explanation: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile
tokens.explanationEn: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile

tokens.bdb: Ashshur, the second son of Shem; also his descendants and the country occupied by them (i.e. Assyria), its region and its empire
tokens.kjv: Asshur, Assur, Assyria, Assyrians. See H838 (אָשֻׁר).

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
tokens.kjv: band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief(-est place, man, things), company, end, [idiom] every (man), excellent, first, forefront, (be-)head, height, (on) high(-est part, (priest)), [idiom] lead, [idiom] poor, principal, ruler, sum, top.

tokens.bdb: a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphemistically the pudenda
tokens.kjv: [idiom] be able to endure, [idiom] according as, [idiom] after, [idiom] coming, [idiom] follow, (broken-)foot(-ed, -stool), [idiom] great toe, [idiom] haunt, [idiom] journey, leg, [phrase] piss, [phrase] possession, time.

tokens.bdb: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
tokens.kjv: again, alike, also, (so much) as (soon), both (so)...and, but, either...or, even, for all, (in) likewise (manner), moreover, nay...neither, one, then(-refore), though, what, with, yea.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
properly, to scrape (literally, to shave; but usually figuratively) together (i.e. to accumulate or increase) or away (i.e. to scatter, remove, or ruin; intransitively, to perish)
tokens.kjv: add, augment, consume, destroy, heap, join, perish, put.
